caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a wooden sleigh with a curved, enveloping body and upwards-sweeping runners. The main body of the sleigh is rendered in shades of red and pink with darker purple and brown shading to emphasize contours and depth. The interior seat and backrest area are shaded in darker brown and gray hues, with visible lines suggesting wood grain and construction detail. The front of the sleigh features a rounded shield or dashboard, colored in dark purple and supported by thin, vertical structural elements. The runners and supporting framework beneath the main body are depicted in lighter pink and reddish tones with additional use of brown for shadowing. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present. The drawing is executed with visible outlines and colored shading to give a realistic representation of the sleigh’s structure and material.
title: One Horse Sleigh
